partners.mechanism_chain: DPAGT1 (HGNC:2865) —DISRUPTS→ N-linked glycosylation (GO:0006486); N-linked glycosylation (GO:0006486) —LEADS_TO→ Global developmental delay (HP:0001263); ALG9 (HGNC:377) —DISRUPTS→ N-linked glycosylation (GO:0006486); N-linked glycosylation (GO:0006486) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal facial shape (HP:0001999). The shared convergence on the N-linked glycosylation pathway links these two diseases mechanistically.
